study type: Case series and retrospective literature review
outcome: Diagnosis of lung cancer during pregnancy
Treatment of lung cancer during pregnancy
Prognosis of lung cancer during pregnancy
cohort: The study included 3 pregnant women diagnosed with lung cancer who were treated at the authors' hospital, along with a review of relevant literature.
finding: Lung cancer during pregnancy is rare, carries a high risk with a poor overall prognosis, but prompt imaging and biopsy are crucial for early diagnosis, and platinum-based chemotherapy is safe in the second and third trimesters.
mod_finding: Two patients had mid-term induction of labor, while one underwent a cesarean section at 37 weeks.
gest_age: Gestational age at diagnosis ranged from 20 to 36 weeks, with one patient undergoing cesarean section at 37 weeks.
